model.method: Stateful walk-forward replay: one legal 15-player squad is carried into the next deadline, re-ranked, transferred and selected using only data available then.
model.objective: Maximise autosubbed XI + captain points, with legal budget/club limits and a season-volatility penalty.

expertTests.label: Patience over churn
expertTests.detail: Bank a transfer unless the best same-position upgrade clears the model hurdle.

expertTests.label: Safety-first captaincy
expertTests.detail: Blend proven output, the immediate fixture and 60-minute security; ownership is only a tiebreaker.

expertTests.label: Expert data layer
expertTests.detail: Add four-GW fixtures, minutes security and ICT involvement to the original Lens feature set.

notes: Every historical GW is recursive: the prior squad, bank and up to two free transfers carry forward; transfers use contemporaneous prices and FPL selling-price rules.
The replay selects a legal formation, orders the bench, applies autosubs and hands the armband to the vice-captain when required.
Age is an availability/consistency prior, not a claim that younger or older players are inherently better.
Current projections are decision support, not guarantees; late team news should override the model.
